findings.detail: Duplicate prevention for ADIANTAMENTO_13 relies solely on the pre-insert checkDuplicateAdiantamento13 read; there is no DB-level unique constraint for tipo='ADIANTAMENTO_13' (the uidx_folhas_cliente_competencia index is intentionally partial to FOLHA_MENSAL only). Two concurrent uploads for the same cliente/competencia could both pass the check and insert duplicate 13º rows (TOCTOU). The catch-block mapping to ADIANTAMENTO_13_DUPLICADO via isUniqueViolation can therefore never actually fire for a real 13º duplicate. This exactly mirrors the existing processarFerias pattern and respects the context constraint that the unique index stay FOLHA_MENSAL-only, so it is a pre-existing design trade-off, not a regression introduced by this task.
findings.fix: Optional / out of scope: if strict 13º uniqueness is ever required, add a second partial unique index (WHERE tipo='ADIANTAMENTO_13') on (cliente_id, competencia) in a future migration. No action needed for this task.

summary: APPROVED. All seven task requirements are implemented correctly and verified. (1) End-to-end ADIANTAMENTO_13 support is wired: isAdiantamento13 detector + extractDadosAdiantamento13 (parser cleanly refactored into extractDadosFolhaComMarcador with an escaped, parameterized page-header marker), controller routing order isReciboFerias -> isAdiantamento13 -> processFolhaFile, processAdiantamento13File with the correct R2 key, duplicate check, and persistence via processarAdiantamento13 (tipo 'ADIANTAMENTO_13', audit acao 'ADIANTAMENTO_13_UPLOADADO', single-CTE atomic insert). The chk_folhas_tipo constraint now allows the three values, and migration 0032_adicionar_adiantamento13.sql + 0032_snapshot.json (fresh id, prevId = 0031's id, 3-value check, partial index preserved) + journal idx 32 are consistent (db:check reports no drift). (2) A dedicated sendAdiantamento13NotificationEmail + buildAdiantamento13Html exist with their own subject/body/operation tag (not a reuse of sendFolhaPagamentoNotificationEmail), wired fire-and-forget skipping suspended/no-email clients; sendFeriasNotificationEmail is left intact. (3) Monthly and ferias paths are unchanged behaviorally and both regression specs pass (only a user-facing error-message string changed on the folha path). (4) The new extraction spec asserts the detector true/false cases and the CNPJ 13.744.722/0001-00 / 4 funcionarios / ALDENORA liquido 862,03 fixture plus the 12-employee totals. (5) The partial unique index stays FOLHA_MENSAL-only while 13º duplicates are guarded by checkDuplicateAdiantamento13. (6) The colaborador API (listRecibos/getReciboDetalhe/getReciboPdf) now returns tipo (defaulting to FOLHA_MENSAL) and the ferias fields additively, and the controller passes the DTOs straight through. (7) ADIANTAMENTO_13 is used consistently everywhere and no throwaway fixture-extraction script remains. Verification run locally: npm run build clean, 25 RH extraction tests green, colaborador-revocation + mail specs green, db:check clean. The only finding is a minor pre-existing TOCTOU note on 13º duplicate prevention that matches the ferias pattern and the index constraint; no blocking or major issues remain.
